result.title: CelluWeave A: Wet compression of cellulose–alginate sheets
result.researchQuestion: Evaluation of the properties of nonliving cellulose–alginate hydrogel sheets under different calcium chloride concentrations.

findings.claim: The 50 mmol/L condition resulted in a mean compressive modulus of 42.0 kPa, shape retention of 96%, and water uptake of 10.0 g water per g dry sheet.
The 75 mmol/L condition resulted in a mean compressive modulus of 56.0 kPa and shape retention of 88%.
The 50 mmol/L condition had a mean compressive modulus of 42.0 kPa and 96% shape retention.
The 75 mmol/L condition had a mean compressive modulus of 56.0 kPa and 88% shape retention.
Higher compressive modulus was associated with poorer shape retention.

limitations: Only two calcium concentrations and one cellulose fraction were evaluated
